mutation: The official run is split over two launches: attempt A (exit -9, interrupted) completes every arm of w_off_1..w_off_5 and records its units with canonical digests; attempt B (launch --stage official --resume, resume_of A, identical lock shas) runs every arm of w_off_6..w_off_8, appending to results/official/OUTPUTS.jsonl.gz with A's rows unchanged; B also re-runs the completed unit (w_off_1, NPT): its rows and receipt now carry B's attempt id. The replay of (w_off_1, W) is bit-identical.
title: resume rewrites a completed official unit
